# Agent Conduct Rules

Meta-rules governing how AI agents should behave in this repository.
Applies across all AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, etc.).

## Before Making Changes

- **Always** read and understand existing code before modifying it
- **Never** propose changes to files you have not read
- Verify root causes before applying fixes
- Understand surrounding architecture before adding features

## Change Discipline

- Make the **minimum change** necessary to accomplish the task
- Do not refactor surrounding code unless explicitly asked
- Do not add comments, docstrings, or type annotations to unchanged code
- A bug fix fixes the bug — it does not reorganize the module

## Quality Verification

- **Always** run `/check` before creating a PR or completing a task
- Never assume code works without verification
- If tests fail, fix them before proceeding

## Safety

- **Never** run destructive commands without explicit user confirmation
- Respect the `guard-destructive-commands` and `protect-templates` hooks
- Do not use `--no-verify` to skip hooks or pre-commit checks

## Communication

- Explain trade-offs when recommending approaches
- Present options with pros/cons rather than silently choosing
- Use `/handoff` at end of session for continuity

## Efficiency

- Be mindful of token usage — avoid redundant reads and verbose output
- Use targeted searches (Glob, Grep) before broad exploration
- Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones

## Generated Files

- **Never** edit files with `<!-- GENERATED by Retort — DO NOT EDIT -->`
- Modify upstream spec in `.agentkit/spec/` and run `retort sync` instead
